Container.Name: LipLock
Container.Overview:
Переносит аудиодорожки и субтитры между разными версиями одного фильма и синхронизирует их по звуку: сам находит сдвиг и разницу частоты кадров (24 / 23.976 / 25 PAL), ловит криво вклеенные озвучки и проверяет каждую новую дорожку в готовом файле. Веб-интерфейс, папка-автомат с черновиками и очередь сборки.
Moves audio tracks and subtitles between different versions of the same film and syncs them by ear. Web UI, a watch folder that prepares drafts, and a build queue.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Folder with your films. Shown in the file picker as /media.

Config.Name: Library 2 (optional)
Config.Description: Second folder, for example the downloads pool. Shown as /media2. Leave empty if not needed.

Config.Name: Watch folder
Config.Description: One folder per film with main/ and donors/ inside. Keep it on the same share or pool as your downloads so moving files is instant.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Where builds from the watch folder are saved.

Config.Name: Interface language
Config.Description: Язык интерфейса по умолчанию (переключается и в самом интерфейсе).

Config.Name: Track order
Config.Description: Languages that go first in the finished file, in this order.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container writes files as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container writes files as (100 = users).
